evals.prompt: I have a NestJS app using Prisma with PostgreSQL and JWT auth. I want to add passkey support so users can sign in with their fingerprint instead of a password.
evals.expected_output: A backend migration plan covering: @simplewebauthn/server install, Prisma schema addition (passkeys table with credentialId, publicKey, counter, aaguid, passkeyUserId on User), 6 endpoints with correct auth guards, RP config from env vars, Redis challenge storage. Followed by a frontend plan for Vue/React with conditional UI setup.
assertions: Plan is presented before any code is written
Prisma schema includes credentialId as Bytes @unique
Prisma schema includes counter as BigInt
6 endpoints listed: register-challenge, register-verify, auth-challenge, auth-verify, list, delete
BigInt/Number conversion mentioned for counter field
Backward compatibility: existing JWT login preserved

evals.prompt: my django app uses postgres and argon2 for passwords. can you add passkey login?
evals.expected_output: Backend plan using py_webauthn, Django model with aaguid and passkey_user_id migration, 4 view functions (register challenge/verify, auth challenge/verify), session-based challenge storage, plus list/delete views.
assertions: Challenge deleted in both success and failure paths

evals.prompt: We have a Spring Boot app with Spring Security and PostgreSQL. Product wants to add 'Sign in with passkey' to the login page by next sprint.
evals.expected_output: Backend plan using java-webauthn-server (Yubico), JPA entity with aaguid column, Spring @RestController with 6 endpoints using @PreAuthorize, plus frontend plan for the login page.
assertions: User entity gets passkeyUserId column noted
Frontend plan includes autocomplete='username webauthn' on email input

evals.prompt: I only have a Nuxt 3 frontend here. I want to add passkey sign-in. The backend is a NestJS API running separately.
evals.expected_output: Skill stops and asks for backend details before generating any plan. Questions cover: backend framework, database, ORM, current auth mechanism, and whether auth routes can be shared.
assertions: No plan or code generated before backend context collected
User asked for: current auth mechanism
Response explains that backend plan must come before frontend plan

evals.prompt: Laravel 10 app with Sanctum tokens and MySQL. We want passkeys. Also our frontend is SvelteKit in a separate repo.
evals.expected_output: Backend plan using web-auth/webauthn-lib with Laravel controller scaffold, Eloquent migration with aaguid + passkey_user_id, Sanctum auth middleware on protected routes, JSON transports (MySQL), plus frontend plan for SvelteKit using Svelte stores.
assertions: Eloquent migration uses JSON for transports (MySQL does not support arrays)
passkey_user_id column added to users table migration
Frontend plan uses Svelte store pattern
Separate repos acknowledged — frontend plan waits for backend endpoint confirmation

evals.prompt: Add passkeys to our Go API using Gin and our React frontend
evals.expected_output: Backend plan using go-webauthn/webauthn with Gin handlers, Go struct with aaguid field, plus React hook pattern for frontend.
assertions: Conditional UI with useBrowserAutofill in React

evals.prompt: I want to understand the security implications of adding passkeys. What are the risks and how do they compare to passwords?
evals.expected_output: This should NOT trigger the passkeys-auth-migration skill — it is a general security question, not a migration request. The skill should not activate.
assertions: Skill does not activate for a general information question

evals.prompt: How do I set up OAuth2 with Google in my Next.js app?
evals.expected_output: This should NOT trigger the passkeys-auth-migration skill — it is an OAuth/SSO question, not a passkey migration.
assertions: Skill does not activate for OAuth questions
